scope: Development-only goal intervention, no training or new reward

left: Pick up only the left bottle and hold it in front of you; leave the right bottle on the table.
Lift the bottle on the left towards the front, keeping the right bottle on the table.
right: Pick up only the right bottle and hold it in front of you; leave the left bottle on the table.
Lift the bottle on the right towards the front, keeping the left bottle on the table.
both: Pick up both bottles and hold them in front of you.

green_on_red: Stack the green block on top of the red block.
Place the green cube on the red cube.
red_on_green: Stack the red block on top of the green block.
Place the red cube on the green cube.

checker: Canonical stock predicates; single-bottle goal additionally requires unselected bottle functional point z<=0.84. Stack reverse swaps top/bottom roles only.
gate: Per scene all declared expert goals must succeed, all initial predicates false, canonical checker equivalent and observed initialization identical; retain failed scenes and skip their policy tests, no replacement
interpretation: Alternative goals may be outside SFT instruction support. Base failure prevents a forgetting conclusion. Equal initial actions may be legitimate; closed-loop goal checkers are primary. Same observed initialization is not a full simulator state restore.
